title: Played pawn sprint, round 2: what ends it? (DPC 0.9.172-dev12)
intro: One controller (or keyboard). Open flat ground with room to run 15+ seconds, out of combat, full stamina, not possessing anyone, co-op off. About 1 minute. Steps with a checklist last until done; End (keyboard) ends any step early.

probes.pspd: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local c = D and D.state.active and D.state.pawn_chara; return c and H.speed(c, 'pawn')
probes.on: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.state.active == true
probes.pdash: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local h = D and D.state.pawn_human; return h ~= nil and h:call('get_IsDash') == true
probes.adash: local a = H.arisen(); local h = a and a:call('get_Human'); return h ~= nil and h:call('get_IsDash') == true
probes.preq: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local q = D and D.native.pip; return q ~= nil and q:get_field('RequestDash') == true
probes.psw: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local q = D and D.native.pip; return q ~= nil and q:get_field('DashSwitch') == true
probes.pkeep: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local q = D and D.native.pip; return q and q:get_field('DashTriggerKeepTime')
probes.pen: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local q = D and D.native.param; return q ~= nil and q:call('get_IsEnableDashAction') == true
probes.pen_h: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local h = D and D.state.pawn_human; return h ~= nil and h:call('get_IsEnableDashAction') == true
probes.atrk: local a = H.arisen(); local h = a and a:call('get_Human'); local t = h and h:get_field('Track'); return t ~= nil and t:call('get_IsDashCancel') == true
probes.ptrk: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local h = D and D.state.pawn_human; local t = h and h:get_field('Track'); local ok, r = pcall(function() return t:call('get_IsDashCancel') end); return ok and r == true
probes.pin: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local function fb(inp) local af = D.af(); local on = inp and inp:get_field('ButtonOnFlags') or 0; local trg = inp and inp:get_field('ButtonTriggerFlags') or 0; local s = ''; if (on & (af.Dash or 0)) ~= 0 then s = s .. 'D' end; if (trg & (af.Dash or 0)) ~= 0 then s = s .. 'd' end; if (on & (af.KeepDash or 0)) ~= 0 then s = s .. 'K' end; return s end; return D and D.state.pawn_input and fb(D.state.pawn_input) or ''
probes.ain: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local function fb(inp) local af = D.af(); local on = inp and inp:get_field('ButtonOnFlags') or 0; local trg = inp and inp:get_field('ButtonTriggerFlags') or 0; local s = ''; if (on & (af.Dash or 0)) ~= 0 then s = s .. 'D' end; if (trg & (af.Dash or 0)) ~= 0 then s = s .. 'd' end; if (on & (af.KeepDash or 0)) ~= 0 then s = s .. 'K' end; return s end; return D and fb(H.ar_input()) or ''
probes.bmode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.brain.on and D.brain.mode or 'off')
probes.bdash: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.brain.on == true and ((D.brain.want or 0) & (D.af().Dash or 0)) ~= 0
probes.drive: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.native.drive)
probes.pstam: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local c = D and D.state.pawn_chara; local m = c and c:call('get_StaminaManager'); return m and m:call('get_RemainingAmount')
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
As the ARISEN: start sprinting and keep it up, straight or wide circles. 10 seconds (End to move on).
Taking over your main pawn. Stand still.
As the PAWN: start sprinting the same way you did as the Arisen and keep it up. 12 seconds.
Stop. Turning OFF the Arisen's follow brain for comparison. Stand still.
As the PAWN again (the Arisen now stands still): sprint the same way. Does it hold now? 12 seconds.
Putting everything back (brain on, back to the Arisen).
Done. Tell Claude: did the pawn hold the sprint in either run? How do you start a sprint (tap or hold, which button)?
